entities.summary: Mary Douglas Tindale was an Australia Australian botanist. She was an Australian botanist specialising in pteridology (ferns) and the genera Acacia and Glycine. She devoted her life to the study of ferns, and her name is widely associated with the group of flowerless plants. Mary Douglas Tindale was a logicians & mathematicians from Randwick (1920-09-19, Randwick–2011-03-31). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
